children: Corvex executed financing transactions to strengthen its balance sheet, completing a private placement for gross proceeds of approximately $33.0 million and granting resale registration rights to participating investors. Under a Securities Purchase Agreement signed August 31, 2026, investors bought 3,904,970 common shares at $7.75 and 353.098 Series D Non-Voting Convertible Preferred shares at $7,750 per share; the financing closed on September 2, 2026. A concurrent Registration Rights Agreement requires Corvex to file a resale registration statement by October 2, 2026 and seek effectiveness within 30 days, subject to exceptions. The company expects the transactions to enhance liquidity and support ongoing initiatives.
